entities.name: Ghalta
entities.description: An elder dinosaur of Ixalan, a manifestation of green mana and the hunger of nature.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The golden city whose opening revealed the elder dinosaurs.

entities.name: Elder Dinosaurs
entities.description: Enormous dinosaurs held in stasis during Orazca's hibernation.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which the dinosaurs were summoned.

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: Summoned Ghalta and the Elder Dinosaurs to battle the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Mavren Fein
entities.description: Vampire commander who followed Ghalta's wake.

entities.name: Beckett Brass
entities.description: Leader of dinosaur poachers in the Echoverse.

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Huatli summoned Ghalta and the Elder Dinosaurs, and Ghalta rampaged among the Phyrexians.
events.quote: Ghalta and the other Elder Dinosaurs were summoned by Huatli to battle the intruders

events.summary: Mavren Fein had his legionnaires follow in Ghalta's wake and dealt serious damage to the invaders.
events.quote: Mavren Fein commanded his legionnaires to follow in the elder dinosaur's wake

relations.quote: Ghalta and the other Elder Dinosaurs were summoned by Huatli to battle the intruders
